responsibility: Provides rustc’s reusable MIR interpretation engine for compile-time execution, combining the core evaluation context and machine abstraction with memory/allocation management, operand/place/projection representations, operator and cast evaluation, single-step statement and terminator execution, intrinsic and caller-location support, trait-object and vtable handling, value traversal and validity checking, and utilities for creating, interning, and extracting interpreter-managed allocations for consts, statics, promoted values, CTFE, and related clients.
